name: Nexus MCP Hive
mission: Parallel work across ALL free OpenCode models, with verified model IDs and automatic fallback

verified.probe_method: opencode run --model opencode/<id> (sequential, 75s cap) + hive-model-probe receipts
verified.note: Roster rebuilt 2026-10-21 from live probes. DEAD ids removed: opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free (fail); opencode/flint-40b-free (fail); opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free (fail); opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free (fail); opencode/big-pickle (fail); opencode/longcat-2.5-preview-free (Endpoint is unavailable); opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free (fail). Only ids that answered are listed. Local floor: ollama/qwen2.5:7b, ollama/qwen2.5:3b.

endpoint_unavailable.ling-3.0-flash-fin-free: 2026-09-29 opencode run -> exit 1 'Upstream request failed: Endpoint is unavailable.' Listed by opencode.models but not serving. No agent may request it.
endpoint_unavailable.muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free: 2026-09-29 removed: no longer returned by opencode.models at all (roster dropped it). Was pictor's primary and vogue's fallback.

rca_2026_10_06.cause: background subagents inherit the orchestrator model when `model` is unset; 4 subagents + orchestrator all streamed mimo-v2.6-flash-free and AI.Error.QuotaExceeded killed all 4 within 7s
rca_2026_10_06.rule: every agent MUST run on a model != the orchestrator model, and dispatch.parallelism stays <= 3

rca_2026_10_21.cause: free model ids rotate upstream — 7/8 rostered ids were gone (instant UnknownError), so the board acked 3/10 in a 537s wall while looking configured; nothing re-verified the roster since 2026-10-14
rca_2026_10_21.fix: sequential re-probe of every live id (hive-model-probe receipts) → roster rebuilt from ids that actually answer; dispatch.parallelism 10 -> 3 (RCA 2026-10-06); a LOCAL ollama floor sits between the cloud fallback and default
